test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

AGREE
solution:
The correct answer is '**Oppose**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Agree**' is '**Oppose**'.
 
• **Agree**: to have the same opinion as somebody/something. (किसी बात या व्‍यक्ति से सहमत होना; एकमत होना)
 
 
• *Example: ‘I think we should leave now.’ ‘Yes, I **agree**.’*
 
 
 
• **Oppose**: to disagree with somebody’s beliefs, actions or plans and to try to change or stop them. [किसी का विरोध करना (उसके विचारों, कार्यों या योजनाओं से सहमत न होना और उन्‍हें बदलने या अवरुद्घ करने का प्रयास करना)]
 
 
• *Example: They **opposed** the plan to build a new road.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Oppose.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Distance**: the amount of space between two places or things. [(दो स्‍थानों या वस्‍तुओं के बीच) दूरी]
 
• **Question**: a sentence or phrase that asks for an answer. [(किसी विषय में) प्रश्‍न, सवाल (किसी बात का उत्तर पाने के लिए प्रयुक्त वाक्‍य या वाक्‍यांश)]
 
• **Support**: to help somebody by saying that you agree with him/her/it, and sometimes giving practical help such as money. [किसी को (सहमति के आधार पर) समर्थन देना या किसी की (धन देकर) सहायता करना]
